text:
maria: Heads up — provisioning in eu-west-1 is failing for a bunch of new GPU nodes, saw ~60% of requests timeout during node bootstrap :rotating_light:
kevin: Seeing the same. kubelets hang on decrypting IAM role creds, errors look like KMS Decrypt failures in the node logs.
infra-oncall: Jumping in — any recent KMS policy or cross-account changes?
sophie: Yes, I pushed a tighten to the keystore role yesterday to block iam:PassRole from the infra service account to reduce blast radius. I thought that only affected control-plane roles.
maria: That probably explains it. The node bootstrap uses a short-lived role to call STS -> then KMS decrypt for disk keys. If PassRole is denied the STS step fails silently and kubelet hangs.
kevin: Stack trace from node agents:
```
2026-03-18T08:12:03Z ERROR: failed to assume-role: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/node-bootstrap
caused by: KMS:Decrypt failed: AccessDenied
```
infra-oncall: Can we revert the PassRole tweak for the infra service account? Rolling back would unblock, but we need a safer long-term fix.
sophie: I can revert but want to avoid reopening the blast radius. Alternative: scope the PassRole permission to the exact ARN used by node bootstrap rather than the broad role pattern.
maria: Rolling back now to restore capacity. Kevin — can you validate node bootstraps after?
kevin: Reverted and policy attached. Kubelet nodes are now succeeding to decrypt, new nodes started ~2m after revert. GPU pool scaling is catching up.
infra-oncall: Good. Two follow-ups:
1) We lost a chunk of audit logs to our central S3 while the nodes failed to push (privatelink endpoint timed out). Need to reconcile logs so we can forensically check which workloads were affected.
2) We should add an explicit canary in the bootstrap flow that fails fast with a clear error when PassRole/STS/KMS combo is misconfigured. Right now it hangs for 10+ minutes.
sophie: For 1) I see the privatelink endpoint got a config change 23:05 last night to tighten allowed source VPCEs (audit policy). That may have blocked node agent uploads. I’ll reopen the endpoint to include the provisioning subnet.
maria: For 2) I'll file a ticket to change the agent: small probe that calls sts:AssumeRole and kms:Decrypt with short timeout and surface structured errors to logs/console. Also add a synthetic check in the node pool autoscaler to detect stuck bootstraps and mark capacity degraded.
kevin: We should also check billing — failed boot retries are inflating our spot instance spend as autoscaler keeps trying. Ops-billing saw a bump. tagging the cost center.
ops-bot: NOTE: Created incident INC-2026-033: "eu-west-1 gpu provisioning outage due to IAM/KMS policy change". Pager duty paged infra-oncall.
infra-oncall: Blocking action items:
- sophie: scope PassRole and reopen privatelink to include provisioning subnet (ETA 30m)
- maria: add bootstrap canary ticket and autoscaler detection (ETA EOD)
- kevin: run audit to reconcile missing logs to S3 and surface any weird blobs (ETA 2h)
- infra-oncall: update postmortem template and tag for compliance review (ETA EOD)

sophie: Done the privatelink update + tightened PassRole to explicit ARN. Watching for any regression.
maria: New nodes stable and GPU pool back to target. I'll monitor for 1 hour and then remove the incident page.
kevin: Runbook note: when KMS Decrypt + sts:AssumeRole errors show up together, check PassRole policy and privatelink endpoint policy in that order. Saving to infra runbook. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks everyone — keeping this as a short postmortem draft in the incident doc. Will link once ready. :eyes:
